for: the laptop, via 0.0.0_AB_MSTR~DELL2 -> laptop 2.0.0_SA_COO~C (as TO-APPLY-Y75's read-back)
why_laptop: row IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-S8: dell2 cannot decrypt irpt-requests and a synthetic advisor cannot own a request (uploads.py:188-195); the laptop can read the records

reads.3a: GET .../analysis/requests/{prospect}/original as the request's OWNER principal: answers a signed link; its sha256 equals the retained original's (the ORIGINAL_HOLDINGS or ORIGINAL_CSV artifact the request binds). NEVER log or store the link; return its sha256 match and expiry only.
reads.3b: the same GET as a principal of ANOTHER firm (any non-49financial firm-bound principal): refused, nothing signed.
reads.3c: a CUSTODY-lane request (no input_id) of the firm: ANALYSIS_ORIGINAL_NOT_APPLICABLE. If none exists in the tenant, return null with exists=false; do not create one.
reads.4: the STORED acceptance record of {ticketed} carries ticket_id == ticket_id_sent (decrypt and read the row), AND GET .../analysis/requests/{ticketed}?include=composition returns composition.ticket_id == ticket_id_sent. This read also grades IRPT_BCKEND TO-APPLY-Y77 read 5a.
reads.5: GET .../analysis/requests/{prospect}/pdf behaves as before: signs if a PDF is retained, else refuses by its same name (ANALYSIS_PDF_NOT_RETAINED).

return.rule: booleans, an expiry and outcome names only; no link, no email, no record body

writes: NONE. Read-only: no delete, no create (3c reads an existing custody request only).
